cc:Work.dc:title: Box - BayonetBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Round box made from layers with twist on top
Glue together - all outside rings to the bottom, all inside rings to the top.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes BayonetBox --diameter 70 --lugs 14 --alignment_pins 1.0 --outside 0 --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes BayonetBox --diameter --lugs --outside --reference --labels
